description: A brown sneaker with long laces sits on a tabletop in front of you. The left hand and right hand move in toward the lace area near the tongue, pinching the laces together as a two-hand object, then the left hand pulls one lace end outward to the left while the right hand holds near the knot area; both hands return to the center to adjust the crossing and tighten, and finally they spread the laces apart and release so the lace ends lie extended on the table.
